decisions.decision: Start with workshop-plan/research/walk-tantra-revops-2026-10-15.json and fix each failure at its source. (1) Simulator: add the endpoints the fixture calls but the simulator lacks: Twilio lookup (twilio-setup said 'not found'), Zoom meetings and polls, GHL workflows (404), the Tantra calendar-campaign create call (it returned {}), and the outreach-sheet share and simulate calls (the 500). (2) Find why ga4-gate failed and fix it. (3) Walker: add the Zoom path to OPTION_CARDS for fixtures that pick Zoom, and add the new content cards to the expected list. (4) d2-close says '2 fields' are left: fill them in the fixture, or fix the centre if the fields are valid. (5) Rerun the walk with the tantra-revops fixture, detached with nohup, so d3-launch gets past the calendar campaign. (6) Run both tsc checks, then commit and push main, add a line to docs/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md, and move the task to review with the report path. If a finding can't be reproduced outside the simulator, write down why it is simulator-only.
